text: EXPLOSIONS IN TEHRAN, IRAN SWARMS HORMUZ; SHIPS ATTACKED AND SEIZED! Breaking War News The EnforcerExplosions have occured in Eastern Tehran, amidst the growing tensions as Iran has invaded the Strait of Hormuz. Dozens of Iranian attack boats swarmed into the Strait, bringing the entire area under direct armed Iranian control. In the midst of this swarm several vessels were attacked, boarded and siezed over the day. Iran has also reiterated the the ongoing US blockade, which also seized 3 ships of it's own in the Indian Ocean, is an act of war requiring a military response. The United States is continuing to discuss how to deal with the issue amongst top cabinet officials. In the middle of discussions in Washington the Secretary of the Navy was fired today by the administration. Ukraine is finally helping US forces at Prince Sultan Airbade to defend themselves against the major drone threat that could emerge if the war restarts. Ukraine has conducted major drone attacks on the Russian Federation once more, with the fire at Tuapse still raging. Ukrainain forces have also inflicted high losses onto the Russian Aremd forces along most of the active front.
